paper: A Metric-Graph Framework for Exact and Robust Threshold Proximity Detection in Discrete-Time Video Observations
scope: Framewise pixel-space implementation; not physical or uncertainty-certified detection

source_metadata.method: image-space pairwise proximity alerts + grid occupancy heatmap
source_metadata.log_sampling: every processed frame; indices a/b are not persistent track IDs
source_metadata.note: Alerts mean estimated box-bottom-center distance <= threshold, regardless of grid. Counts are detections per processed frame, not unique visitors. Feet are estimates. No calibration, motion analysis, or temporal confirmation. Proximity does not establish an emergency. Occupancy color saturates at 5 and never triggers an alert. Frame percentages refer only to processed frames.

conventions.identities: Frame-local detections only; component IDs also frame-local
conventions.matrix_order: matrix_axis_labels for global matrices; cell labels for within-cell matrices
conventions.no_pair: nearest_pair_distance_px and threshold_margin_px are null when fewer than 2 detections; paper uses +infinity for nearest distance. Alarm false; max depth 0 by convention.
conventions.cells: Rectangles width=W/cols, height=H/rows; floor assignment; final boundary assigned to final cell. Out-of-frame points rejected.
conventions.search: Exact rectangle set-distance = hypot(max(0,abs(delta_col)-1)*cell_width, max(0,abs(delta_row)-1)*cell_height); retain if <rho
conventions.time: Nominal output playback time only; actual original frame indices/timestamps unavailable
conventions.components: Connected components include isolates; nontrivial components have >=2 nodes. Connected does not imply all pairs are close.
conventions.severity: max(0,rho-nearest_distance) in pixels, threshold depth only, not validated danger
conventions.counts: Summed edges across frames are repeated pair observations, not distinct events

unavailable_reasons.physical_calibration: No ground reference correspondences or calibration map
unavailable_reasons.uncertainty_certification: No justified deterministic localization-error bounds; confidence is not an error bound
unavailable_reasons.temporal_exposure: No persistent identities or source timestamps
unavailable_reasons.sampling_guarantee: No defensible pairwise motion bounds or measured sampling gaps

summary.search_scope: Comparison counts for standalone localized detection vs all-pairs. Export computes both for validation and full matrices; no runtime speedup claimed.
